items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Lee Collins was on trumpet and ... myself on drums.

ctx.x: That was after the, I don't know what happened after the Orchd. But I moved down to the Cadillac Café. That's just before I went into the Lyric Theater. And Albert Nicholas was playing clarinet. Lee Collins was on trumpet and Lu Russel was on piano and myself on drums.

items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: did you hear any old records I made with Mez? ... Zutty Singleton, the great jazz that I think would always say... I made with Mez? ... Mez Row. Zutty Singleton

ctx.x: Well he said to tell everybody how low for him too. Yeah, they look good, Manuel did. He's pretty heavy, but he's good health though.

And I go to work in Astoria, I mean entertainers, playing this band. And this was a band, that time was the talk of New Orleans. We kept it everything. Packed and jammed every night. Fake Marbles band was in there. And I got Zooty's wife's brother, Cornet Flair.
